issue.description:
Child 4 of 4 re-splitting beadrs-56d1568d. Consolidates the verbatim evidence recorded by children 1-3 into the parent's notes, so the parent's final acceptance criterion ("verbatim command outputs recorded in this bead's notes before closing") is met without one dispatch re-running every probe.

Scope:
1. Read the recorded notes of the three sibling beads (bead show <id>)
2. Append a consolidated evidence block — command plus verbatim output per probe, each attributed to its child bead ID — to beadrs-56d1568d notes, guarded by --if-revision against the bead's current revision so a concurrent writer is never clobbered
3. Do NOT close beadrs-56d1568d: closing the parent stays with the dispatcher once the whole chain is green

Acceptance:
- beadrs-56d1568d notes contain all three verbatim probe outputs, each attributed to its child bead ID
- The notes write used --if-revision and either succeeded or was retried against the fresh revision (no lost update; exit 4 means re-read and retry)
- No git state changes, no commits, no hand-edited files under .beads/ — all bead writes go through the bead CLI
issue.title: Assemble git-state evidence into beadrs-56d1568d notes

issue.description:
ADR-004 commits to a pinned MSRV lane (`cargo +1.85 check --all-targets`) so the declared floor is tested on every CI run instead of asserted, and states that drift between the lane's toolchain and the manifest's `rust-version` is a CI failure, not a doc nit. No open bead covers the lane. Add the step to the bead-rs-ci Argo WorkflowTemplate (declarative-config/k8s/iad-ci — GitHub Actions stay disabled), pin the toolchain to exactly the manifest's rust-version, fail the lane on mismatch, and require the lane after dependency refreshes. Verify: green on current main, and demonstrably red when the manifest floor is artificially raised above the pinned toolchain.

Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned Rust 1.85 MSRV verification lane to bead-rs-ci
